english.notes: This offence is no longer valid in relation to a requirement imposed by a waste collection authority in England; such matters have been decriminalised form 15th June 2015. The appropriate procedure for a failure to comply in England is outlined in sections 46A - 46D of the Environmental Protection Act 1990.
